{{Short description|English and American statistician}}

'''Mike West''' is an English and American statistician.  West works primarily in the field of [[Bayesian statistics]], with research contributions ranging from theory to applied research in areas including finance, commerce, macroeconomics, climatology, engineering, genomics and other areas of biology.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mike West The Arts & Sciences Professor of Statistics & Decision Sciences Department of Statistical Science |url=http://www2.stat.duke.edu/~mw/ |website=Duke University}}</ref> Since 1999, West has been the Arts & Sciences Distinguished Professor of Statistics & Decision Sciences in the Department of Statistical Science at [[Duke University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Scholars at Duke |url=https://scholars.duke.edu/person/mw |website=Duke University}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
West earned a BSc in mathematics in 1978, and then PhD in mathematics (Statistics) in 1982, from the [[University of Nottingham]].{{citation needed|date=September 2023}} He worked at [[University of Warwick|Warwick University]] before joining [[Duke University]] in 1988, where he became the Director of the Institute of Statistics and Decision Sciences (ISDS)<ref>{{cite web |title=Department of Statistical Science |url=https://stat.duke.edu/about/history |website=Duke Trinity College of Arts and Sciences}}</ref> from 1990 to 2001.

West has made significant contributions to Bayesian theory and methods for [[time series]] analysis and forecasting.<ref name="ts">{{cite book |last1=Prado |first1=Raquel |last2=Ferreira |first2=Marco AR |last3=West |first3=Mike |title=Time series: modeling, computation, and inference |date=2021 |publisher=CRC press}}</ref><ref name="bay">{{cite book |last1=West |first1=Mike |last2=Harrison |first2=Jeff |title=Bayesian Forecasting and Dynamic Models |date=1997 |publisher=Springer |isbn=0-387-94725-6 |url=https://bayanbox.ir/view/5561099385628144678/Bayesian-forecasting-and-dynamic-models-West-Harison.pdf}}</ref><ref name="app">{{cite book |last1=Pole |first1=Andy |last2=West |first2=Mike |last3=Harrison |first3=Jeff |title=Applied Bayesian Forecasting and Time Series Analysis |date=1994 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=9780367449384 |url=https://www.routledge.com/Applied-Bayesian-Forecasting-and-Time-Series-Analysis/Pole-West-Harrison/p/book/9780367449384}}</ref> He has also conducted research on non-parametric Bayesian analysis with methodological and applied research that include implementations of [[Dirichlet process]] mixture models starting with a paper published in 1995.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Escobar |first1=Michael |last2=West |first2=Mike |title=Bayesian density estimation and inference using mixtures |journal=Journal of the American Statistical Association |date=1995 |volume=90 |issue=430 |pages=577–588 |doi=10.1080/01621459.1995.10476550 |url=https://users.wpi.edu/~balnan/Escobar-West-1995.pdf}}</ref> His research with molecular geneticists and clinical researchers involved developing predictive models for identifying types of breast cancer using gene expression data,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=West |first1=Mike |last2=Blanchette |first2=Carrie |last3=Dressman |first3=Holly |last4=Huang |first4=Erich |last5=Ishida |first5=Seiichi |last6=Spang |first6=Rainer |last7=Zuzan |first7=Harry |last8=Olson Jr |first8=John A |last9=Marks |first9=Jeffrey R |last10=Nevins |first10=Joseph R |title=Predicting the clinical status of human breast cancer by using gene expression profiles |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |date=2001 |volume=98 |issue=20 |pages=11462–11467 |doi=10.1073/pnas.201162998 |pmid=11562467 |pmc=58752 |bibcode=2001PNAS...9811462W |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bild |first1=Andrea H |last2=Yao |first2=Guang |last3=Chang |first3=Jeffrey T |last4=Wang |first4=Quanli |last5=Potti |first5=Anil |last6=Chasse |first6=Dawn |last7=Joshi |first7=Mary-Beth |last8=Harpole |first8=David |last9=Lancaster |first9=Johnathan M |last10=Berchuck |first10=Andrew |last11=Olson Jr |first11=John A |last12=Marks |first12=Jeffrey R |last13=Dressman |first13=Holly K |last14=West |first14=Mike |last15=Nevins |first15=Joseph R |title=Oncogenic pathway signatures in human cancers as a guide to targeted therapies |journal=Nature |date=2006 |volume=439 |issue=7074 |pages=353–357 |doi=10.1038/nature04296 |pmid=16273092 |bibcode=2006Natur.439..353B |s2cid=4418878 }}</ref> contributing to the popularisation of [[biomarker discovery]] through gene expression profiling.

West has been a consultant with various companies, banks, government agencies and academic centres, co-founder of a biotech company, and board member of several financial and IT companies.  West has also served the international statistics profession in founding roles and as a board member in a number of national and international centres and institutes as well as professional societies.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

== Elected positions & honours ==
President of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] in 2009–2010.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

Elected Fellow of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] in 1982, of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1993, of the [[American Statistical Association]] in 1993, of the [[International Statistical Institute]] in 1997, and elected inaugural fellow of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] in 2012.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

Founding Chair of the [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]] (ISBA) section on Economics, Finance, and Business in 2012-2013<ref>{{cite web |title=Section on Economics, Finance, and Business – Past Officers |url=https://bayesian.org/sectionschapters/economics-finance-and-business/economics-finance-and-business-past-officers/ |website=ISBA}}</ref>

Chair of the [[American Statistical Association]] section on Bayesian Statistical Science in 2010.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}}

*American Statistical Association, NC Chapter Award for development of statistics and contributions to theory and practice<ref>{{cite web |title=Mike West is recipient of award from ASA NC Chapter |url=https://stat.duke.edu/news/mike-west-recipient-award-asa-nc-chapter |website=Duke Trinity College of Arts and Sciences|date=12 October 2014 }}</ref>
